What if your words matter more than your thoughts?

Kevin explains that, in his view, your tongue is a creative force and words carry real power. He says a spoken word has far more force than a silent thought.

He also points to a few books on the topic and says to be careful what you say about yourself and your life.

Which do you say more often when you talk to yourself, kind words or harsh ones?

Edison and Einstein shared one habit most people skip.

Kevin explains that Thomas Edison would nap an hour or two in his workshop, and Einstein did the same. He says they were so obsessed with their work that they stopped only when their bodies gave out, then went right back to it.

He adds that you may not need to be that fanatical, but this is what they did.

What project could you lose track of time on?
